results.lean_predicate:
structure Input where
  actionCount : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  actionCount : Nat
  displaying   : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => true
  post := fun i o => o.actionCount = i.actionCount ∧
                     (o.displaying = true ↔ i.actionCount > 0)

example : Spec.pre { actionCount := 5 } ∧
          Spec.post { actionCount := 5 } { actionCount := 5, displaying := true } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
results.bad_example:

Requirement 2.2.4/S1 (GENERAL DESCRIPTION > Product Functions > Score.):
The product must record the score (time and number of counts) of a play associated with the name of a user.
results.lean_predicate:
structure Play where
  name  : String
  time  : Nat
  counts: Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  user  : String
  play  : Play
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  user  : String
  play  : Play
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.user ≠ ""
  post := fun i o => o.user = i.user ∧
                     (o.play.name = i.play.name ↔ true) ∧
                     (o.play.time = i.play.time ↔ true) ∧
                     (o.play.counts = i.play.counts ↔ true)

example : Spec.pre { user := "alice", play := { name := "level1", time := 120, counts := 5 } } ∧
          Spec.post { user := "alice", play := { name := "level1", time := 120, counts := 5 } }
                    { user := "alice", play := { name := "level1", time := 120, counts := 5 } } := by
  unfold Spec; decide

Requirement 3.2.1.4.3/S2 (SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS > Functional Requirements > Actions. > Block movement > Processing):
The selected block can' mt ove near other blocks at least 0.05x from the others blocks.
results.lean_predicate:
structure Block where
  position : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  selectedBlock : Block
  otherBlocks   : List Block
  distance      : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  selectedBlock : Block
  otherBlocks   : List Block
  accepted      : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.distance ≥ 5
  post := fun i o => (o.accepted = true ↔
    ∀ other ∈ i.otherBlocks, i.selectedBlock.position + 5 ≤ other.position - 1 ∨
    other.position + 5 ≤ i.selectedBlock.position - 1) ∧
    (o.accepted = false ↔
    ∃ other ∈ i.otherBlocks, i.selectedBlock.position + 5 ≥ other.position ∨
    other.position + 5 ≥ i.selectedBlock.position)

example : Spec.pre { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [], distance := 10 } ∧ Spec.post { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [], distance := 10 } { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 16 }], accepted := true } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
results.bad_example:
example : Spec.pre { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 15 }], distance := 10 } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 15 }], distance := 10 } { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 15 }], accepted := true } := by
  unfold Spec; decide

negative_examples.example:
example : Spec.pre { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 15 }], distance := 10 } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 15 }], distance := 10 } { selectedBlock := { position := 10 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 15 }], accepted := true } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
negative_examples.why: The output accepts the movement even though the selected block is too close to another block
